title: Treasury Yields Surge as Oil, Buyback Results Fuel Selloff
summary: The US bond-market selloff accelerated on Thursday as spiking oil prices fanned inflation fears and the Treasury Department bought fewer bonds than expected during its first expanded buyback operation.

title: Bessent Dismisses Concern on Buyback, Says Treasuries Are Strong
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent dismissed any concerns with regard to Thursday’s smaller-than-expected debt buyback operation, and played down concerns about a jump in yields.

title: Fanatics’ King on Sports Betting and Prediction Markets
summary: Fanatics’ Betting and Gaming CEO Matt King discusses the company’s newly launched all-in-one app, which combines sports betting, casino, and prediction markets. King discusses Fanatics’ position in a market long dominated by DraftKings and FanDuel, and asked King how much share Fanatics has gained so far. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Strahan and Schwartz-Morini on Athlete Economy

(Source: Bloomberg)

title: NSE Downsizes India IPO, Showing Mounting Valuation Concern
summary: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd., the world’s largest derivatives exchange by volume, has downsized its initial public offering, a sign of rising concern over the willingness of investors to buy into the deal at the valuation the firm had been seeking.

title: Matt Freese on US Soccer Post World Cup

title: Philip Morris CEO Is ‘Optimistic’ About Zyn Potential
summary: Jacek Olczak discusses Zyn's strong demand and asking whether those issues have now been resolved. The conversation also focused on Philip Morris International’s year-end market share target for Zyn and whether offering larger cans with 15 to 20 pouches could boost revenue as well as margins. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Barington Takes New Stake in Bath & Body Works
summary: Barington Capital Group, the activist investor with a long track record in retail, has taken another stake in Bath & Body Works Inc. and is recommending the personal-care and fragrance store chain to explore a sale.

title: FanDuel CEO on Sports Betting
summary: Christian Genetski, President of FanDuel discusses the business of sports betting with Bloomberg’s Scarlet Fu at Bloomberg Power Players 2026 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Municipal Bond Yields Soar to Highest Since 2011 in Rout
summary: Municipal bond yields jumped as much as 15 basis points with the longest-dated securities reaching the highest since 2011, as rising Treasury rates and heavy new issuance pressure the market.

title: Stocks, Bonds Drop as Oil Spike Boosts Fed Wagers: Markets Wrap
summary: Another rally in oil prices spurred losses in stocks and bonds, with the latest inflation data reinforcing bets the Federal Reserve will increase rates soon amid pressures from higher energy costs.

title: US Yields at Multiyear Highs Bring Buyers to 30-Year Auction
summary: Yields on US government debt rose to fresh multiyear highs — stoking demand for an auction of 30-year bonds — as surging oil prices bolstered the case for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike as soon as next week.

title: Yankees, Vanderbilt on the Evolution of College Sports

(Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dollar Rises as Fed Hike Bets Grow Heading Into Inflation Report
summary: The dollar rose as strong US producer prices and an oil rally boosted bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes this year, putting more focus on Friday’s inflation report.

title: Dispersion In High Yield Idiosyncratic: Steinbach

Margaret Steinbach, fixed income asset class lead at Capital Group, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the gap between spreads between CCC and single B bonds in the high yield market.

title: S&P 500 Slides Fourth Straight Day as Oil Prices, Yields Surge
summary: US stocks fell for a fourth straight day, their longest slide since June, as the relentless climb in oil prices and fresh evidence of sticky inflation boosted Treasury yields and bets the Federal Reserve will lift interest rates.

title: NYC Transit Agency Prepares $785M Mansion Tax Bond Sale
summary:
Bloomberg's Michelle Kaske joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." New York City’s transit network is planning to offer $785 million of debt backed by a levy on sales of luxury real estate.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Connecticut Surplus Deposits to State Pensions Top $11B
summary:
Bloomberg's Martin Braun joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Connecticut transferred about $1.3 billion in excess revenue this latest fiscal year to underfunded state employees’ and teachers’ pensions, bringing surplus deposits to more than $11 billion over the last seven years, state Treasurer Erick Russell said Tuesday.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
